description: Self-contained Copper CRM REST API workhorse. Header-based API-key auth (X-PW-AccessToken / X-PW-Application / X-PW-UserEmail). Retry on 429 / 5xx with exponential backoff (honors Retry-After). Generic get/post/put plus search(object_type, filter_body) and upsert(object_type, search_filter, create_body) -- Copper has no native atomic upsert, so upsert() emulates one via search-then-write.

outputs.description: CopperResource with get/post/put/search/upsert convenience methods. Consumed by copper_record_upsert (sink) and by custom Dagster asset code that needs Copper People/Leads/Companies CRUD.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Copper API key (sent as X-PW-AccessToken).

user_email.label: User Email
user_email.description: Email address of the Copper user the API key belongs to. Required by Copper on every request as X-PW-UserEmail.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retry attempts on 429 / 5xx (exponential backoff, honors Retry-After).

name: Copper Resource
